technical_and_design_decisions: Use Maven for build automation and CI integration.
Leverage Spring Boot for Boot-based ModuleRunner implementation.
Use Kafka as the messaging backbone for the XD + Kafka POC.
Implement pluggable SPI for module deployment abstraction.
Use JMH for performance benchmarking of TupleBuilder.
Integrate GPDB and SQLServer via Sqoop for parameter UX testing.
assumptions: Developer has prior experience with Spring XD and Kafka.
Existing codebase and dependencies are accessible.
CI infrastructure (e.g., Jenkins/GitHub Actions) is available.
Sample repositories are accessible for publishing POCs.
Performance benchmarks will be run on standard hardware.
GPDB and SQLServer test environments are available.
